caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed frame, which consists of four cylindrical legs, a rectangular horizontal frame made up of long side rails and short end rails, and a solid headboard that is slightly curved at the top. The bed frame is shown in a brown color, representing wood grain texture, with visible construction details such as rounded tops on the posts and a series of regularly spaced round holes along the inner faces of the rails. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige or off-white background, with no other objects present. The artist’s name, “Albert S. Mowery,” is written in small script in the lower left area of the image.
title: Shaker Bed
